header.running_head: Visiting the Ill and What to say to them

blocks.arabic_text: لَا شِفَآءَ إِلَّا شِفَآؤُكَ شِفَآءً لَّا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
blocks.text:
Another narration adds the words:
"There is no cure like Your cure. Grant a cure that does not leave out any illness."[^2]

blocks.arabic_text: لَا بَأْسَ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِيْ لَا يَكْشِفُ الضُّرَّ إِلَّآ أَنْتَ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Ali (RA) also reports that whenever Rasulullaah ﷺ visited a sick person, he would place his right hand on the person's right cheek and say:
"O Rabb of mankind, remove the difficulty. You grant a cure for only You can cure. There is none but You who can remove ailments."[^3]

blocks.arabic_text: أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِيْ لَا شَافِيَ إِلَّآ أَنْتَ شِفَآءً لَّا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ visited a sick person, he would say:
"O Rabb of mankind, remove the difficulty. You grant a cure for only You can cure. There is none who can cure but You. Grant a cure that does not leave out any illness."[^4]
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) reports that when Rasulullaah ﷺ visited a sick person, he would place his hand on the part of the person's body that was in pain and then say:[^5]

blocks.arabic_text: كَشَفَ اللّٰهُ ضُرَّكَ وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ وَعَافَاكَ فِيْ دِيْنِكَ وَجَسَدِكَ إِلٰى أَجَلِكَ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) says that Rasulullaah ﷺ one visited him when he was ill. As Rasulullaah ﷺ prepared to leave, he addressed Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) saying:
"May Allaah alleviate your difficulty, forgive your sins and grant you well being in your Deen and your body until the day you die."[^6]

blocks.arabic_text: أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِيْ لَا شَافِيَ إِلَّآ أَنْتَ شِفَآءً لَّا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) reports that whenever Rasulullaah ﷺ went to see a sick person or whenever a sick person was brought to him, he would say:
"O Rabb of mankind, remove the difficulty. You grant a cure for only You can cure. There is no cure like Your cure. Grant a cure that does not leave out any illness."[^7]
